note: Description taken from Sands' 1965 revision of Harris' 1954 original description (in English), including the alate and soldier; the worker is not treated separately; all measurements are Sands' new pooled values (14 alates, 29 soldiers). The OCR misread decimal points as hyphens or colons (e.g. I-39 for 1.39, 0:79 for 0.79), restored here by magnitude; illegible means are not cited.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Most closely related to N. elegantulus (the differences are discussed under that species); alate compound eyes relatively large compared with head width (eye width index 2.4—2.6), postclypeus inflated (2.0—2.3 times as wide as long); the soldier shows marked size variation, colonies may contain individuals of different instars, which may be regarded as residual or incipient polymorphism.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Chiefly supplementary to Harris' 1954 original description: eye width index 2.4—2.6; postclypeus inflated, 2.0—2.3 times as wide as long; female cerci slightly shorter than to slightly longer than the basal width. Measurements (14 specimens, 2 localities, mm): head width (across the eyes) 1.20—1.36 (mean 1.27); greatest diameter of the compound eye 0.48—0.55 (mean 0.51); ocellus 0.13—0.16 × 0.16—0.20 (mean 0.14 × 0.19); ocellus to eye 0.01—0.03 (mean 0.02); pronotum width 0.94—1.18 (mean 1.05); pronotum length 0.56—0.72 (mean 0.66); hind tibia length 1.38—1.64 (mean 1.51); fore wing length 9.90—12.20 (mean 11.18).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Chiefly supplementary to Harris' 1954 original description: nasus cone angle 10—17 degrees; postmental plate weakly convex in lateral view. Cephalic bristles: 1 pair on the vertex, occasionally 1—2 small beard-like bristles at the base of the nasus, rather many bristles at the tip of the nasus, occasionally 4 of them more prominent than those behind; scattered minute bristles elsewhere on the head. Abdominal tergite bristles scattered and short, the marginal bristles small and sparse, scarcely visible without high magnification; sternite bristles sparse and short, longer at the posterior margin. Measurements (29 specimens, 13 localities, mm): head length (to the tip of the nasus) 1.61—2.05 (mean 1.78); head width 0.88—1.29 (mean 1.05); head capsule depth 0.61—0.82 (mean 0.66); pronotum width 0.43—0.64 (mean 0.53); pronotum length 0.15—0.25 (mean 0.22); hind tibia length 0.89—1.28 (mean 1.04).
